benchmarks.name: Kpler
benchmarks.observedPrinciple: The product narrative separates foundational market data, derived insight and decision tools, creating a monitor-understand-act path.
benchmarks.applicationToNjia: Make Njia's hierarchy read as signal -> ranked opportunity -> investigation -> evidence rather than a sequence of equally loud sections.

benchmarks.name: Palantir Foundry/AIP
benchmarks.observedPrinciple: Operational intelligence is organized around decisions and real-world objects, with evidence and context attached to action.
benchmarks.applicationToNjia: Keep route, product, confidence, freshness and evidence visually connected to the decision surface.

strengths: Strong signal-to-opportunity information architecture already exists.
Ask the Market creates an intuitive commercial entry point.
Evidence and demo/illustrative labeling are explicit.
Semantic details, tables, headings and navigation preserve understandable structure without JavaScript.

defects.finding: Current --ink-faint (#77817b) is approximately 3.54:1 on --paper and --ochre (#a77942) is approximately 3.38:1 on --paper, while both are used for small text or text-adjacent UI. This is below the 4.5:1 target for normal text.
defects.repair: Darken muted/ochre text tokens while retaining Njia's mineral/rust identity.

defects.finding: Several labels use 0.58rem-0.66rem type, creating avoidable legibility and density problems in an intelligence product.
defects.repair: Raise minimum micro-label sizes and line-height, particularly evidence, captions, tags and table metadata.

defects.finding: Five signal cards remain in one row until 1050px, compressing headings, metrics and decision links through common laptop widths.
defects.repair: Move the 3-column transition to a wider breakpoint and normalize card borders/min-heights.

defects.finding: The hero can dominate the first viewport while downstream command surfaces have similar visual weight, delaying the market-state read.
defects.repair: Tighten hero scale/spacing and increase separation between narrative, command and evidence surfaces.

defects.finding: Links/details are functional but visual feedback is understated relative to the information density.
defects.repair: Strengthen hover/open/focus states without adding ornamental motion or changing behavior.

defects.finding: Seven desktop navigation items create a long horizontal rail and the header loses context during a very long intelligence page.
defects.repair: Use a sticky, bounded command header with clearer active/hover affordance while preserving all links.

art_direction_v1.direction: Kenyan market-intelligence field journal meets professional trading desk: warm mineral paper, deep green-black ink, restrained rust signal accents, compact evidence typography, crisp rules, minimal radius, and stronger spatial hierarchy.
avoid: decorative gradients that reduce data legibility

requirements: Focus indicators remain high-contrast and visible.
Details/open states remain native and keyboard-operable.
Hover states may increase contrast or surface emphasis but may not hide information.
Reduced-motion preference must continue to disable non-essential transitions.
